t: No more than $500,000 of the funds appropriated or made available in this Act shall be used during a single fiscal year for any single relocation of an organization, unit, activity or function of the Department of Defense into or within the National Capital Region: Provided, That the Secretary of Defense may waive this restriction on a case-by-case basis by certifying in writing to the congressional defense committees that such a relocation is required in the best interest of the Government.

fable.w: The only procedural step is a written certification from the Secretary of Defense to the congressional defense committees. Congress and its committees are inside the federal government, so this never crosses the federal boundary. The tempting reading treats the certification as consultation, but no state, tribe, expert, company, or member of the public is involved in the relocation or waiver decision.
fable.s: the Secretary of Defense may waive this restriction on a case-by-case basis by certifying in writing to the congressional defense committees

opus.w: The only step required before the Secretary can waive the funding limit is a written certification to the congressional defense committees. Those committees are part of Congress, so this is communication inside the federal government. It may look like a step before a decision, but no state, tribe, expert, company, or member of the public is consulted, gets a hearing, or can object.
opus.s: the Secretary of Defense may waive this restriction on a case-by-case basis by certifying in writing to the congressional defense committees that such a relocation is required in the best interest of the Government

qwen_chat.w: The section allows the Secretary of Defense to waive a restriction by certifying to congressional defense committees. Congress and its committees are part of the federal government. The definition explicitly states that reports to or notifications of Congress are not participation. There is no consultation with states, tribes, the public, or other outside entities.
qwen_chat.s: the Secretary of Defense may waive this restriction on a case-by-case basis by certifying in writing to the congressional defense committees that such a relocation is required in the best interest of the Government.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that the Secretary must "certify in writing to the congressional defense committees," which sounds like a formal interaction. However, Congress is inside the federal government. Reporting to or notifying Congress is explicitly excluded from the definition of participation. The waiver is a unilateral executive action subject to internal reporting, not a consultation with an outside party.
